chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
MaelSechnaill, Helmikki, Kauppi, Inggifu, Mingirdė, Eadred, Branán, Lemppi, Lemmikki and Dervorgilla arrived together in summer.

The founding party had two adult cows and one adult bull and 1 longship.

MaelSechnaill, Helmikki, Kauppi and Lemmikki worked as woodworkers. Inggifu, Eadred, Branán and Lemppi worked as hunters. Mingirdė worked as a fisher. Dervorgilla worked as a farmer.

Helmikki and Lemppi were already partners. Dervorgilla and Kauppi were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.
